data.long_meaning: The name Heathcote is derived from Old English words. 'Heath' means heather-covered land, while 'cote' means enclosure or shelter. This name was popular in the Middle Ages and was given to children born on heather-covered land or to those who lived in an enclosure on such land. The name Heathcote carries the meaning “Heath enclosure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Heathcote usually hope their child will grow to embody heath enclosure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
